shortDescription: Manage UDP profiles on a BIG-IP

options.name: datagram_load_balancing
options.description: When C(true), specifies the system load balances UDP traffic packet-by-packet.

options.name: idle_timeout
options.description: Specifies the length of time a connection is idle (has no traffic) before the connection is eligible for deletion. When creating a new profile, if this parameter is not specified, the remote device will choose a default value appropriate for the profile, based on its C(parent) profile. When a number is specified, indicates the number of seconds the UDP connection can remain idle before the system deletes it. When C(indefinite), specifies UDP connections can remain idle indefinitely. When C(0) or

options.name: name
options.description: Specifies the name of the profile.

options.name: parent
options.description: Specifies the profile from which this profile inherits settings. When creating a new profile, if this parameter is not specified, the default is the system-supplied C(udp) profile.

options.name: partition
options.description: Device partition to manage resources on.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: state
options.description: When C(present), ensures the profile exists. When C(absent), ensures the profile is removed.
